title: Sweet Child O' Mine
hook: Why Sweet Child O' Mine sounds *like a memory*

chords.name: C
chords.text: *C major* isn't in D. Borrowed, it softens the shine.

chords.name: G
chords.text: *G major* lifts you up, like sun through a window.

chords.name: D
chords.text: Home again, *warm and a little wistful*.
